_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "banks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sender_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "bank_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES banks (id), "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("channel", "pattern"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "normalized_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "merchant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES merchants (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "match_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parser_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "bank_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES banks (id), "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_defaults" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "date_formats" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sample_raw_message_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "bank_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES banks (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "last4" TEXT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "auto_created" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_created" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("bank_id", "last4"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "email_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "auth_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_cursor" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("email", "auth_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "bank_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES banks (id), "sender" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "email_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES email_accounts (id), "sim_slot" INTEGER NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NULL, "parse_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subscriptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "merchant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES merchants (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_charged_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "next_expected_at" INTEGER NULL, "price_changed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("price_changed" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "unused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("unused" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder_days" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "txn_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES merchants (id), "payee_raw" TEXT NULL, "ref_no" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "balance_minor" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "subscription_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES subscriptions (id), "notes" TEXT NULL, "user_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_edited" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "raw_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES raw_messages (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "upcoming_charges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "subscription_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES subscriptions (id), "merchant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES merchants (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mandate_ref" TEXT NULL, "raw_message_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES raw_messages (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "matched_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX txn_dedup ON transactions (account_id, amount_minor, occurred_at)
